label: 回看
note: 回看 (look-back) post type: fills an account's day when fresh publishable material is thin. Material is the account's OWN tier-B X sources and donors from about a year ago (Feb 2025 first, then the same calendar window one year before the day), fetched by twitter241 date-bounded search; each draft compares what was said then with today's numbers from live/charts.py fetchers and carries a then-vs-now chart. FD_ARCHIVE unset or 1 = on for enabled_accounts only; FD_ARCHIVE=0 = off. Raw fetched posts stay outside git (FD_ARCHIVE_RAW); the ledger lives in live/store/archive_lookback (ignored).
pilot_reason: Oct 8 pilot: the three accounts with the thinnest fresh material in a simulated 2026-10-08 selection (daily_compose.select over all 20): crypto_altcoin_zh 1 timely of 2 planned (0 fresh on 10-07 morning, 3 of 5 drafts held), crypto_macro_en 0 timely of 2 planned (largest EN crypto gap), zh_longterm_investing 0 fresh packets at all (macro_zh / market_data_charts beats).
